_comment: Audit trail of every keyword research run. One entry per run — used to debug queue state and verify deduplication history.

runs.notes: First manual run. Competitor identification returned empty — domain too new/small for Ahrefs organic competitor tracking. 'free seating chart template' dropped at dedup check — already a secondary keyword of published article wedding-seating-chart-template.

Mechanical guardrail (Step 3) passed 22 unique keywords after within-batch and cross-set dedup, but manual relevance curation discarded 13 of those before queueing, beyond what the substring inclusion/exclusion filter alone catches: 'pew' and 'rentals' and 'seating' are bare dictionary words that only match because the guardrail terms themselves ('pew', 'rental', 'seating') are substrings of them, with Ahrefs parent_topics confirming unrelated intent (e.g. 'pew' -> parent topic 'black'). 'guest list' was confirmed off-topic by its own SERP, which is dominated by the novel/show 'The Guest List' by Lucy Foley, not wedding planning content. 'foam board near me' SERP is dominated by local hardware/craft listings (Sutherlands, Office Depot) for raw foam board, not printed seating charts -- poor fit for a customer already choosing a finished product. 'free seating chart maker for teachers' and 'free classroom seating chart maker' carry classroom/education intent, not wedding intent (neither 'classroom' nor 'teacher' happen to be in the exclusion list, only 'school' is -- a gap worth adding to guardrails.exclusion_any). 'seating chart printable' and 'how to make a seating chart' are near-duplicates of the already-published wedding-seating-chart-template and how-to-make-a-wedding-seating-chart articles (which predate the queue system and have no queue_id to attach cluster_siblings to) and were dropped to avoid cannibalization. 'rental service', 'arch wedding', 'standard foam board size', and 'reception tables' matched guardrail terms by coincidence but describe products/services Howard Wedding Rentals does not offer (only the four active pillars: church pew rental, place cards, seating chart boards, seating chart tool). 'church pews' (plural of the already-published 'church pew') was added as a cluster_sibling of kw-001 instead of a new queue entry to avoid splitting ranking signal for a near-identical query. Net: 8 new queue entries (kw-008 through kw-015) and 1 cluster_siblings update.
